name: FT232H ST7789 4383 Display Demo
description: Tests the Adafruit 1.14in 240x135 ST7789 TFT (PID 4383) driven over SPI by an FTDI FT232H breakout, wired through a Jumperless V5 crossbar. Responds to checkin, configures the display, then writes test messages. FT232H Blinka pins: SPI = SCK/MOSI/MISO (D0/D1/D2), CS=D4, DC=D5, RST=C0 (D3 is not exposed by the FT232H board module; RST is on C0 to spread crossbar lanes across chips and keep SCK/MOSI/CS/DC each on a dedicated 2-switch path).

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and board capabilities

steps.name: add-display
steps.description: Configure the ST7789 TFT (240x135, SPI) on the FT232H

steps.description: Write a test message to the display
